blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · The Membrasin® System includes two clini
blocks_element.text: The Membrasin® System includes two clinically backed, hormone-free products that work together to restore intimate moisture and comfort: Membrasin® Vitality Pearls, a once-daily oral supplement rich in omega-7 sea buckthorn oil that nourishes your vaginal tissues from within, and Membrasin® Intimate Moisture Cream, a soothing topical formula that delivers instant relief to dry, irritated external skin. This powerful inside-out system improves hydration, elasticity, and overall vaginal health — helping you feel like yourself again with every use.

Vitality Pearls
Take 2 soft gels daily by mouth with a light meal and plenty of water. For the best results, take consistently for a minimum of 90 days to allow SBA24® to nourish the mucous membranes of the vaginal lining.

Intimate Moisture Cream
Apply as needed with clean fingertips to the intimate skin to help reduce itching and irritation caused by dryness. Apply before bed to allow for optimal absorption.

blocks_element.repere: Texte · Are Membrasin products only for those go
blocks_element.text: Are Membrasin products only for those going through menopause?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · No. Membrasin may be helpful for women e
blocks_element.text: No. Membrasin may be helpful for women experiencing vaginal dryness, irritation, or tissue discomfort during midlife and beyond. These changes often become more noticeable during perimenopause and menopause, but dryness can happen at different stages of life.
